claimPolicy.reason: The suite certifies ToonStudio release governance, reader policy, series lifecycle, analytics import, and upload-ready packages. It does not operate third-party publisher accounts.

lanes.title: Release approval, scheduling and replacement
lanes.outcome: Only approved immutable releases can publish; scheduled promotion, replacement, collaboration policy, and unpublish remain auditable.

lanes.title: Reader visibility and community policy
lanes.outcome: Public, link-only and private publication policies control reader access, comments, remix and public metadata consistently.

lanes.title: Generic, WEBTOON and Tapas delivery packages
lanes.outcome: Destination packages are deterministic, privacy-safe, policy-versioned, finalized with hashes, and checked against committed goldens.

lanes.title: Ongoing, hiatus and completed series
lanes.outcome: Creators can pause and resume a series without losing episodes or allowing invalid lifecycle states.

lanes.title: Privacy-preserving publication analytics
lanes.outcome: User-supplied CSV and manual observations are bounded, normalized and compared locally without claiming remote platform telemetry.
